description.text: Ecology is a science that studies the interrelationships between organisms and their environment, as well as among organisms themselves, covering multiple levels such as individuals, populations, communities, ecosystems, and global ecology. The course centers on "Understanding Ecological Mechanisms - Solving Environmental Problems", integrating theory, experiments and field practice to cultivate students' abilities to analyze ecological phenomena and address ecological challenges.

duration.text: The Ecology at South China Normal University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4166 USD/per year ￥ 30000 CNY/per year

materials.text: (1) Equal to a bachelor's degree (or above) in China;(2) Full transcripts of final education, original or notarized version, in notarized Chinese or English Translation.(3) A scanned copy of score reports of the HSK tests. Admitted students are required to submit original copies of those official documents for verification. Those who provide fake materials will be disqualified from admission.(4) Personal statement in Chinese or English including study and working experience (if available), academic research experience and results, research proposal and so on (including applicants' understanding of the discipline or major they are applying for and their plan, about 800 words).(5) Two recommendation letters in Chinese or English from professors or associate professors in the graduated university or college.(6) A scanned copy of passport valid for more than 6 months.(7) A scanned copy of passport including the photo page, and all pages with visa records, and entry and exit stamps (if available).(8) Single person color photo without a hat, taken recently within the last 6 months, same size as the one on the passport.(9) Other requirements★ Applicants are required to submit additional materials if necessary.★Documents that can prove applicants’ comprehensive abilities, such as certificates of awards, certificates, admission letters from foreign universities and so on, can be submitted together with their application.★ Application materials will NOT be returned regardless of the application result.

requirements.text: 2.1 General requirements(1) Applicants must abide by the laws and regulations of China and the rules and regulations of the university, and respect Chinese social customs.(2) Applicants should be healthy, both physically and psychologically, with no criminal record, and meet the physical standards required for applying for a student visa or residence permit.2.2 Age and identification requirements(1) Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with valid passports.(2) Applicant should be at least 18 years old and not more than 35 years old (Scholarship applicants should meet all age requirements).2.3 Academic requirements(1) Equal to a bachelor's degree (or above) in China;(2) Full transcripts of final education, original or notarized version, in notarized Chinese or English Translation.2.4 Language proficiency(1) Applicants should obtain an HSK (Level 5) certificate after February 2023.(2) A scanned copy of score reports of the HSK tests. Admitted students are required to submit original copies of those official documents for verification. Those who provide fake materials will be disqualified from admission.2.5 Financial conditionApplicants should be able to pay tuition fees, accommodation and related daily living expenses.
